label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_00
text: Forgive me, my friends...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_system_01
text: About a year and a half ago...

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_01
text: Forgive me. It took a goodly time to procure\nthe required materials.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_honooboss_01
text: Whoaaa, sick! These boots are insaaaaaane![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_02
text: Ah, yes. The move Flame Charge was my muse\nfor those particular pieces.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_kakutouboss_01
text: This outfit is everything I imagined it would be.\nThank you so much![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_03
text: I merely wished to create a costume worthy of\nthe great Infernal Eri. If it aligns with your vision,\r\nthen I am content.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_01
text: Seems our outfit upgrades are all wrapped up,\nthen! Thanks a ton, Atticus.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_02
text: With you two lookin’ like absolute beasts,\nanyone who crosses us will be sweatin’ bullets![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_doku_040_fairyboss_01
text: You’re so good at these sorts of crafty things,\nAtticus.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_doku_040_fairyboss_02
text: Those people bullying you ’cause you geek out\nover old-fashioned stuff are out of their minds.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_04
text: The way of the ninja is rough and fraught with\nthorns. I neither expect nor desire sympathy from\r\nthe unrefined rabble.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_honooboss_02
text: Oooh, someone’s gettin’ fired up! Watch out,\nworld—our Atticus has FIGHTIN’ words![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: ajito_doku_040_kakutouboss_02
text: Yeah, don’t listen to the haters, Atticus. I think\nyou’re really cool![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_03
text: All right, gang. Let’s move on to the next step.\c\nIt’s time to put our backs into our battle training\nso we’re all prepped for Operation Star.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_doku_040_akuboss_04
text: We gotta be stronger than everyone else in the\nteam—that’s what bein’ a boss means![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_05
text: Indeed it does. Henceforth, I will devote myself\nheart and soul to honing my battle skills![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_06
text: For the sake of the team, I would give my very\nheart and soul...but I cannot defy the rules.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_07
text: Our code must be obeyed.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_08
text: And so...this badge is mine to keep no more.\nI entrust it to thy care.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_waza_01
text: Take this contraption, too. It contains a technique\nthat allows one to cover their foes in gunk.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_09
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] is thy name,\nis it not?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_10
text: You have utterly bested me. But thy victory stir’d\nno bitterness within me—such was its brilliance.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_01
text: Don Atticus!

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_11
text: M-my compadre?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_01
text: It seems this little fella has been dying to speak\nwith you face-to-face.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_02
text: Don Atticus, please, hear what I have to say!\nI only need a moment!

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_12
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_02
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_13
text: Whatever brought you all the way here?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_03
text: I came to help you!

label: ajito_doku_040_student_04
text: If you don’t start going to class again, you’ll be\nexpelled from the academy, right?

label: ajito_doku_040_student_05
text: When the other kids at school and I were getting\nbullied real bad, you and the rest of Team Star\r\nsaved us!

label: ajito_doku_040_student_06
text: Thanks to that operation you carried out,\nwe were all able to go to school again!

label: ajito_doku_040_student_07
text: If you got expelled for being the good guys,\nthat’d be the worst thing ever!

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_15
text: Forgive me...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_08
text: Haven’t you heard anything from the big boss...?

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_16
text: Nay, we’ve heard not a whisper since that\nfateful day...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_17
text: Without the big boss, Team Star cannot carry on.\c\nAnd without the team, the bright and merry\nstudent life we seek lies beyond our reach![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_18
text: We’ve no choice but to defend our bases till\nthe big boss returns to us![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_09
text: You evidently trust this big boss of yours a great\ndeal. Who exactly are they?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_19
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_10
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_20
text: In truth, not one of us has met them in the flesh.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_11
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_21
text: By their own word, they are a recluse. As with the\nrest of us, ’twould seem bullying was to blame.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_12
text: That’s awful...

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_22
text:
Though their name and face be unknown to us,
they are nonetheless our precious comrade.\c
Our only choice is to maintain our vigils from
the bases, awaiting the day of their return.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_13
text: So that’s why you don’t go to school...

label: ajito_doku_040_student_14
text:
But...but still! Don’t ever think that Team Star is
all you have, Don Atticus!\c
You’ve got a lifelong compadre in me—and don’t
you forget it!

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_23
text: My compadre...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_15
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_16
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_24
text: I owe you a great debt.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_03
text: It seems we’re one step closer to the truth behind\nTeam Star’s truancy—and the bullying at the\r\nacademy. But more importantly...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_04
text:
I can’t believe I had no idea about these issues
the students are struggling with...\c
They have friendships they hold dear and reasons
for acting as they do. I just couldn’t see it.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_040_nelke_05
text: It’s shameful how oblivious I’ve been.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: ajito_doku_040_student_17
text: [EMPTY 61]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_25
text: Haaah... I believ’d Team Star to be the one and\nonly treasure in my life...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: ajito_doku_040_dokuboss_26
text: Methinks I may have been mistaken.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
